subject: general
question: Which of the following is a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghoomar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghoomar** is a traditional** folk dance of Rajasthan**, performed by **women** on special occasions and festivals.
 
• It involves **graceful movements,** twirling in circles, and clapping to the beats of the music.
 
• The dance form has gained popularity worldwide, especially after it was featured in the Bollywood **movie 'Padmavat'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Giddha is a traditional folk dance of Punjab, performed by women during harvest season.
 
 
• It involves high-energy movements and singing of folk songs. 
 
 
 
• Bihu is a folk dance of Assam, performed during the Bihu festival.
 
 
• It involves brisk movements and is accompanied by traditional music. 
 
 
 
• Bhangra is a folk dance of Punjab, performed by men during harvest season.
 
 
• It involves energetic movements and is accompanied by traditional music.
